_comment: Patient-specific benchmark cases. The patient for each case is the first booking (by PatientID) matching `scenario` + `withdrawal_type` in synthetic_ground_truth, so cases stay valid if the dataset is regenerated with the same seed. Gold patient facts (earliest/latest score, change, count) are computed at evaluation time by an independent SQL implementation, not by backend/services/timeline.py. `guideline_gold` names an anchor set in `guideline_gold_sets` (manually checked against chunk text); null means no single gold guideline topic.

alcohol_monitoring.text: at least every 8 hours during alcohol withdrawal management until the CIWA-Ar score remains below 10
